text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: `inference-eu-queue-throttle` (sev2). Affected: Hosted API (eu-west-1). Symptoms: spike in 429s and queue growth. Samples: customer requests failing, elevated tail latency. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-queue-throttle

pagerduty: Paging maya (primary on-call) — escalation policy: inference-prod -> oncall-sre. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-98234

maya: Ack. I'm on it. Checking autoscaler, pool health, and kvcache metrics. Will update in 2m. :eyes:

oliver: pinging infra to check any infra-wide noise, but happy to take if you want to hand off.

maya: thx @oliver. initial glance: pool-42 showing rapid connection churn, kvcache eviction rate up x6. Trying quick mitigation: restart pool-42 to reclaim memory and warm KV. Command I'm rolling now:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference-pool-42
```

incident-bot: Restart job queued and started (job id 87321). Notifying on-call.

tess: If you need overnight coverage, I can take a handoff after stabilization.

kevin: If restart doesn't move 429s within 3m, escalate to eng-runtime and trigger model-fallback routing to smaller model variants. Also consider temporary rate-limit increase for dedicated customers.

maya: Update +90s: restart triggered, pods cycling. Grafana snapshot: 429 rate down ~40% from peak, queue depth trending down. Link: https://grafana.redwood/inference/eu/pool-42

oliver: Nice, looks like cache pressure was the root cause. Any postmortem action items?

maya: Quick notes: add a kvcache eviction alert with lower threshold, and add a runbook step to scale pool before restart. I'll keep ownership for next 30m and then hand off to @tess if stable. Notifying support for customer comms. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: Incident still open. Acknowledged by maya. Please update PD incident status when escalating or resolving.

maya: Will do. If we see reoccurrence, escalate to eng-runtime (kevin) and open an infra bridge. For now marking as "working" and monitoring for 10m.

kevin: Copy. If needed I can prepare a temporary routing policy to divert traffic to eu-central.

oliver: Thanks — filing a short follow-up ticket for alert tuning: INT-8492.

incident-bot: Note logged: restart completed. Pods healthy. Timestamp 2945679120.

maya: Final update +8m: 429s dropped to baseline, queue stable. Support notified, no customer escalations yet. I'll transition to watch handoff to @tess in 20m unless something flares. Closing PD once stabilized for 30m. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Please mark incident resolved when thirty-minute stability window completes.

maya: Acknowledged. Keeping thread live for handoff notes.
